note: Export activity is factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records: 5 visible export rows dated 2026-02-10 to 2026-02-24, all air shipments from Ahmedabad Air cargo to Karachi (Pakistan), Dhaka (Bangladesh) and Cairo (Egypt), with B/L numbers 9533823, 9605626, 9732827, 9814268, 9984550. Declared HS 293311 (nitazoxanide-type anthelmintic API) is broadly consistent with the observed cargo 'PHARMACEUTICAL RAW MATERIAL NITAZOXANIDE', though the customs lines carry HS 29341090, 29224990 and 29362290 — the actual codes differ from the declared one, so per project rules the code should be corrected to the observed codes and the verdict kept as accepted_hs_corrected, not rejected. Company is an API/pharma raw-material exporter and also an importer of Chinese chemicals (BSM Chemical, Jiangxi Xinhai), i.e. it buys intermediates and re-exports finished API — role is best described as manufacturer_trader/unknown pending registry check (registries out of scope here). Caveat on source reliability: ImportKey free view is a partial paywalled extract; the 140-shipment figure is the site's own counter and only 5 rows were actually visible, so the total volume is unverified. Domestic (India) supply side remains unverified — no GST turnover band, no GeM/CPPP tender, no contract found; this is a gap, not a negative finding.
